proof_summary: Define the candidate sequence by \(b_{n+3}=4b_{n+2}-b_n\) and track the residual \(r_n=b_{n+1}^2-b_nb_{n+2}\); induction gives \(r_{n+3}=4r_{n+1}+r_n\) together with \(0<r_n\le b_n\), using positivity and the growth bound \(b_{n+1}\ge2b_n\). Hence \(b_{n+1}^2=b_nb_{n+2}+r_n\) has a positive remainder no larger than the divisor, so \(\lceil b_{n+1}^2/b_n\rceil-1=b_{n+2}\), proving that the original nonlinear recurrence coincides with the linear one.
